title: An acting atom with two sides held is a gate, and every map of held inputs is self-dual
subject: Which input-output maps a knot memory computes from points held by the world, and whether they are learned natively
conclusion: Flipping every point leaves the dissonance unchanged, so every map from held inputs is self-dual and none computes AND, OR or XOR of two inputs; an acting atom with two sides held is a gate (proved; exact). A learner seeing only its dissonance under the world's clamps learned gates at single atoms, NOT included, but not through composites (computed).
